body:
I saved the cloth with sticky pollen for you. The orchard spray test crew passed the late afternoon; the mare refused her feed, and afterward the bridge was blocked.

I had promised to bring this home for supper. Its date and the empty chair at the table now belong to the same evening.

I could have mistaken the order in which those things happened. I could not mistake the empty place left for the person we had been waiting for.
title: Handwritten letter

body:
I asked for clean water. The man with the bucket asked how many people were still here before he opened it.

I pointed to the room behind me. He wrote down a smaller number and said the others would be counted separately. He would not say where.

The bucket was emptied on the floor after he left. I kept the scrap he dropped because it has the number he first wrote.
title: Handwritten letter
